title: Rewards Bonus for Superhosts Holding a Roamhaven Rewards Membership
content:
# Superhost Perk Table — Rewards Bonus for Hosts Who Are Roamhaven Rewards Members (Host Accounts)

A Roamhaven travel credit of a Host Accounts Superhost also carries a Rewards bonus, set by the host's own Roamhaven Rewards membership (the guest loyalty programme the host holds as a traveller):

| The host's Roamhaven Rewards membership | Rewards bonus |
|---|---|
| Active, at Rewards Platinum, Rewards Diamond or Rewards Ambassador | USD 40.00 |
| Active, at Rewards Silver or Rewards Gold | USD 20.00 |
| Any other case | No Rewards bonus |

The Rewards bonus is added to the base amount and the stays bonus before that sum is rounded.

## Reading the table

- The membership must be active. A Roamhaven Rewards membership at Rewards Diamond that is suspended, closed or pending confirmation earns no Rewards bonus.
- An active membership at Rewards Member earns no Rewards bonus.
- A host with no Roamhaven Rewards membership earns no Rewards bonus.
- Hypothetically, a Superhost holding an active Rewards Gold membership receives a Rewards bonus of USD 20.00 on the credit.
